第二十三章 闭关苦修双境连破（第1页）
辞别师尊与忧心忡忡的韩清鸢，陈默抱着小白狐回到厢房，反手紧闭房门，布下双层聚灵隔音结界。
结界一成，屋内彻底隔绝外界所有嘈杂风声与府内巡逻动静，只剩浓郁且精纯的天地灵气缓缓流转。
他盘膝坐于蒲团之上，指尖轻轻摩挲胸口温热的净心符，心中危机感愈发浓烈。
【我目前修为卡在炼气六层巅峰，看似距离七层只有一步之遥，可放在即将到来的世家混战里，依旧不堪一击。每月五十枚下品灵石俸禄杯水车薪，资源紧缺，强敌环伺，我必须尽快突破。】
他转头看向身旁乖乖趴坐的小白狐，此刻小雪修为停留在炼气七层，此前吞噬火莲积攒了海量底蕴，只是一直没有彻底引爆，迟迟没有突破。
【小雪身怀火莲本源，底蕴远超同阶修士，趁着这次闭关，正好让它一并突破，多一分实力，便多一分活下去的底气。】
心念落下，一人一狐同时闭目，开始潜心冲击修为瓶颈。
陈默双手结修行印诀，净心符白光缓缓流淌，清灵之力冲刷识海，让他彻底摒弃杂念，心神空明无垢。
他接连吞下三枚固元丹，温润药力瞬间炸开，顺着经脉奔涌至丹田。周遭灵气疯狂被他吸入体内，如同百川归海，不断冲刷那层卡在六层巅峰许久的无形瓶颈。
初期灵力冲撞，经脉阵阵酸胀刺痛，瓶颈坚硬无比，数次冲击尽数溃散。
陈默咬紧牙关，不动分毫，借着净心符稳固心神，调动全身所有灵力，凝聚成一股尖锐灵力洪流，狠狠朝着瓶颈轰然撞去！
桎梏彻底碎裂，丹田瞬间扩张一圈，周身灵气疯狂灌入体内，修为水涨船高，稳稳踏入炼气七层！
一股更加强劲、凝练的灵力游走四肢百骸，浑身疲惫一扫而空，五感也变得更加敏锐，甚至能透过结界，模糊感知到院外巡逻弟子细微的脚步动静。
陈默缓缓吐出口浊气，眼眸睁开，一抹精光转瞬即逝。七层的灵力，让他催动阴魄剑时，也能承载更强的剑气，战力实打实提升一截。
小白狐：炼气七层→连破两级，抵达炼气九层
相比于陈默循序渐进的突破，一旁的小白狐突破则更为迅猛霸道。
它本就吞噬过地心火莲，体内封存着海量精纯火属性本源，之前一直压制境界，只为稳固根基，此刻彻底放开压制，厚积薄发。

小白狐周身骤然泛起一层赤红火焰光晕，温暖霸道的火灵之力席卷整间厢房，火莲本源之力彻底苏醒。
第一层瓶颈应声破碎，直接跨过炼气八层，没有丝毫停滞，磅礴火灵之力继续暴涨，顺势冲击下一层壁垒！
不过半柱香的时间，第二重瓶颈再次碎裂！
没有瓶颈卡顿，没有灵力空虚，凭借火莲留下的恐怖底蕴，小白狐一口气连破两级，直接从炼气七层，跨越八层，稳稳踏入炼气九层！
雪白狐毛之下，淡淡火纹若隐若现，它赤红色的眼眸愈发透亮，周身气息强横无比，远超如今的陈默。
它轻轻晃了晃蓬松尾巴，抬头看向陈默，发出软糯的狐鸣，亲昵地蹭了蹭他的手背，似乎在分享突破的喜悦。
陈默看着气息暴涨的小白狐，眼中满是欣慰。
一人一狐双双突破，屋内灵力与火灵气息交织在一起。
陈默抬手收起结界，推开房门，晚风扑面而来，庭院之中夜色已深。
他望着远处林家方向灯火通明、彻夜不休的巡逻人影，心中无比清醒。
他刚入炼气七层，小雪已是炼气九层，看似实力大涨，可面对两家联手的危机，依旧远远不够。
风云愈烈，乱世将至，修行之路，依旧不能停下。

Chapter 23: Retreat and practice hard in two realms (page 1)
After bidding farewell to his master and the worried Han Qingyuan, Chen Mo returned to the wing with the little white fox in his arms, closed the door tightly with his backhand, and set up a double-layered soul-gathering soundproof barrier.
Once the barrier is complete, the house is completely cut off from all the noisy wind and patrols in the house, leaving only the rich and pure spiritual energy of heaven and earth flowing slowly.
He sat cross-legged on the futon, his fingertips gently rubbing the warm Heart Purification Talisman on his chest, and the sense of crisis in his heart became stronger.
[My current cultivation level is stuck at the peak of the sixth level of Qi Refining. It seems that I am only one step away from the seventh level, but in the upcoming melee between the aristocratic families, I am still vulnerable. The monthly salary of fifty low-grade spiritual stones is a drop in the bucket. Resources are scarce and powerful enemies are around. I must break through as soon as possible. 】
He turned to look at the little white fox sitting obediently next to him. At this moment, Xiaoxue's cultivation level was stuck at the seventh level of Qi Refining. She had accumulated a huge amount of knowledge by devouring the fire lotus, but it had never been completely detonated and had not yet made a breakthrough.
[Xiaoxue possesses the origin of the fire lotus, and her foundation far exceeds that of monks of the same level. Taking advantage of this retreat, she can let it break through together. The more strength it has, the more confidence it will have to survive. 】
With their thoughts down, one person and one fox closed their eyes at the same time, and began to concentrate on attacking the bottleneck of cultivation.
Chen Mo formed a practice seal with his hands, and the white light of the Purifying Talisman flowed slowly. The power of the pure spirit washed away the sea of ​​consciousness, allowing him to completely abandon distracting thoughts and his mind was clear and untainted.
He swallowed three Yuan-Guating Pills in succession, and the warm and moistening medicine exploded instantly, rushing along his meridians to his Dantian. The spiritual energy around him was absorbed into his body like a river returning to the sea, constantly washing away the invisible bottleneck that had been stuck at the peak of the sixth level for a long time.
In the early stage of the collision of spiritual energy, the meridians were sore and tingling, and the bottleneck was extremely hard, all of which collapsed after several impacts.
Chen Mo gritted his teeth and didn't move an inch. He stabilized his mind with the Heart Purification Talisman, mobilized all the spiritual power in his body, condensed it into a sharp torrent of spiritual power, and crashed towards the bottleneck!
The shackles were completely shattered, the Dantian expanded in an instant, and the spiritual energy all over the body was poured into the body crazily. The cultivation level increased, and the boat was steadily stepped into the seventh level of Qi refining!
A stronger and more condensed spiritual power traveled through the limbs and bones, all fatigue was swept away, and the five senses became more acute. You could even vaguely perceive the subtle footsteps of the patrolling disciples outside the hospital through the barrier.
Chen Mo slowly exhaled the turbid breath, opened his eyes, and a flash of light disappeared. The seventh level of spiritual power allows him to carry stronger sword energy when he activates the Yin Soul Sword, and his combat power is truly improved.
Little White Fox: Seventh level of Qi refining → Break through two levels in a row and reach the ninth level of Qi refining
Compared to Chen Mo's gradual breakthrough, the little white fox on the side broke through more quickly and domineeringly.
It has swallowed the Earth Core Fire Lotus, and has a massive amount of pure fire attribute sealed within its body. It has been suppressing its realm before, just to stabilize its foundation. Now it has completely let go of the suppression, and has accumulated a lot of accumulation.
The little white fox's body suddenly glowed with a halo of red flames. The warm and domineering power of the fire spirit swept across the entire room, and the original power of the fire lotus was completely awakened.
The bottleneck on the first level was shattered, and it passed directly across the eighth level of Qi Refining without any stagnation. The power of the majestic fire spirit continued to surge, and it took advantage of the trend to hit the next level of barrier!
Within half a stick of incense, the second bottleneck shattered again!
There was no bottleneck or emptiness in spiritual energy. With the terrifying heritage left behind by the Fire Lotus, the little white fox broke through two levels in one go, directly from the seventh level of Qi Refining, to the eighth level, and steadily stepped into the ninth level of Qi Refining!
Under the snow-white fox fur, faint fire patterns were looming, its crimson eyes became brighter and brighter, and the aura around it was extremely powerful, far more powerful than Chen Mo's today.
It shook its fluffy tail slightly, looked up at Chen Mo, made a soft fox cry, and rubbed the back of his hand affectionately, as if sharing the joy of breakthrough.
Chen Mo looked at the breathThe little white fox's eyes were filled with joy.
One person and one fox both broke through, and the spiritual energy and fire spirit breath in the room were intertwined.
Chen Mo raised his hand to put away the barrier, and opened the door. The evening breeze blew in his face, and it was already dark in the courtyard.
He looked at the brightly lit patrol figures in the distance in the direction of Lin's house all night long, feeling extremely sober in his heart.
He had just entered the seventh level of Qi refining, while Xiaoxue was already at the ninth level. It seemed that his strength had greatly increased, but in the face of the crisis of the two companies joining forces, it was still far from enough.
The storm is getting fiercer and troubled times are approaching, but the path of spiritual practice still cannot be stopped.
